subject: sherbet-shell snail
pose: 三分之二侧面，身体轻抬
requested_medium: translucent resin and whipped ceramic render
art_direction: 螺旋壳像歪斜汽水软冰塔，半透明薄荷身体与短触角带来慵懒神态。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Design a snail with a shell resembling a leaning tower of whipped ceramic folds, alternating dusty pink and hot tangerine. Its body is translucent mint resin with a matte belly, not slimy skin. Two stubby antennae bend at different angles above a relaxed face. Pose it in three-quarter view, lifting the front of its body as if pausing mid-glide. Place it on a dark desaturated teal field with a restrained contact shadow. Show tiny glaze pooling inside the shell folds while keeping the body shape simple and readable. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for distinct original concept, appealing silhouette and expression, requested medium, coherent shape/anatomy, clean visual hierarchy, no text or watermark
